h: Holiness Opens the Blessings of Children Life and Sustenance

p: Hashem, may He be blessed, gave the blessing
it expounds the juxtaposition of the parshiyos:
מְאֵרַת ה׳ בְּבֵית רָשָׁע (מִשְׁלֵי ג, לג)
"'The curse of Hashem is in the house of the wicked' (Mishlei 3:33)
"therefore it placed after the parshah of the nazir
for he merits to receive the blessings.
The juxtaposition of the parshiyos of nazir and sotah
is found in the Gemara as well
that "whoever sees a sotah in her disgrace
should separate himself from wine," etc.;
"One who sets his eyes on his cup
seem to him like level ground."
And the nazir for the sake of Heaven
And the root of the blessings
for in all three of them we find blessing:
is the blessing of the fish,
"The blessing of Hashem, it makes rich";
"And He will bless your bread and your water,
and I will remove illness," etc.
To Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
was said the blessing of the stars,
And of Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
and not the silver and gold of Avimelech";
וְחַיֵּי מָצִינוּ בְּיַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
And life we find with Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
who was blessed with eternal life,
and a comparison is not drawn halfway:
for he too radiates to his offspring
so that whoever is of the seed of Yaakov
and death is only like sleep,
"And when you awaken, it will speak with you"
and it is only like one awakening from his sleep.
in the three of Birkas Kohanim.
refers to the blessing spelled out
that is, the first blessing in the Torah,
"May Hashem shine His face upon you"
"In the light of the King's face is life."
"May Hashem lift His face toward you"
וְאֵיךְ לֹא אֶשָּׂא פָּנִים לְיִשְׂרָאֵל וְכוּלֵּי
"And how shall I not show favor to Yisrael," etc.,
to the size of an olive," etc.
And why did they single out
But it is measure for measure:
because of this Hashem, may He be blessed,
bestows upon them food and blessing
And it concludes "and grant you peace";
who gave "bread according to the little ones" (Bereishis 47:12)
for even in the lifetime of Yaakov Avinu
he saw six hundred thousand of his offspring
and Yosef lived after him for many years,

p: it says in the holy Zohar
the daughter is crowned with the Avos
"a name better than sons and daughters";
and nature was not altered for them,
they were promised an everlasting name
and a name better than sons and daughters;
and especially one fit to have children
merits the blessing of actual children.
the increase in words of Torah,
which are the offspring of the righteous,
"The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life," etc.,
is as we say on Shabbos:
and the intent is also Torah,
רְאֵה נָתַתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ אֶת הַחַיִּים וְגוֹ׳
"See, I have set before you life," etc.;
as it says (Bereishis Rabbah, beginning of chapter 11, 11:1):
"'The blessing of Hashem, it makes rich'
the wealthy outside the Land of Israel
it is in the merit of their honoring Shabbos.
Now from the side of man:
(Midrash Rabbah and Tanchuma, beginning of Parshas Kedoshim):
therefore the parshah of the nazir is stated
But Hashem, may He be blessed, gave
from the side of Hashem, may He be blessed:

paragraphs.text: Source of the quoted words: Sanhedrin 93b — “בשלמא למאן דאמר שנסתרסה עבודה זרה בימיהם, היינו דכתיב: ״כה אמר ה׳ לסריסים אשר ישמרו את שבתתי וגו׳״. אלא למאן דאמר סריסים ממש, משתעי קרא בגנותא דצדיקי? הא והא הוה …” — “The Gemara asks: Granted, according to the one who says that idol worship was emasculated during their lifetime, that is as it is written: “For so says the Lord to the sarisim who observe My Shabbatot, and choose what pleases …”

paragraphs.text: Source: Mishlei 11:30 — “פרי צדיק עץ חיים ולקח נפשות חכם” — “The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; The wise captivate people.”

paragraphs.text: Source: Devarim 30:15 — “ראה נתתי לפניך היום את החיים ואת הטוב ואת המות ואת הרע” — “See, I set before you this day life and prosperity, death and adversity.”

paragraphs.text: Source: Devarim 10:12 — “ועתה ישראל מה יהוה אלהיך שאל מעמך כי אם ליראה את יהוה אלהיך ללכת בכל דרכיו ולאהבה אתו ולעבד את יהוה אלהיך בכל לבבך ובכל נפשך” — “And now, O Israel, what does the ETERNAL your God demand of you? Only this: to revere the ETERNAL your God, to walk only in divine paths, to love and to serve the ETERNAL your God with all your heart …”
